items.description: Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving tasks, judging results, and refining workflows, reaching a win rate of nearly 70 percent against the base model after two rounds. items.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
items.description: Microsoft researchers found that autonomous AI agents get trapped in what they call "idea basins" because of their growing chat context, local solution regions they can't escape. Their "Fork-and-Flush" method clears the chat history but keeps the workspace, achieving up to 66 percent better results on the same compute budget. items.description: Andrej Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI and now at Anthropic, sees a widening knowledge gap in AI.
